L012.title: Regular 3-polytopes of order 2^n p
L012.edition: arXiv:2001.02945v2, 14 July 2024; the local filename is not an edition date

extractor: page.extract_text(visitor_text=visitor), full pages joined by one newline; check exact font alignment
selection: Every physical page, title, abstract, body, acknowledgements, bibliography. Remove only occurrence-bound page numbers and repeated running furniture. No body-only selection.
calibration: Visible glyph identity only, read from the exact rendered PDF and embedded fonts. Bind each substitution to font, codepoint, page, offset and context, and original text bytes where needed to disambiguate encodings. No mathematical/language correction, dehyphenation, deletion, rearrangement or OCR substitution. Reject unresolved control/private-use/replacement glyphs; retain raw sensitivities.

unit_definitions.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in text)

primary_program_boundary: All six complete mathematical programs, including all embedded diagnostics, printed once in the full eight-page appendix. All six full raw files are the alternative representation, never added to the printed appendix.

comparison_policy.written: whole L012 / (whole U_Affine + whole AF1), first comparison
comparison_policy.including_program: whole L012 / (whole U_Affine + whole AF1 + whole CODE), separately reported required-program-inclusive comparison
comparison_policy.raw_program_alternative: whole L012 / (whole U_Affine + whole AF1 + all six whole raw required programs), alternate program representation
comparison_policy.conditional: whole L012 / whole AF1, after acquiring the WHOLE U_Affine and ALL SIX complete required programs

auxiliary_list_discrepancy.original_cost_boundary_drivers: check.py and controls.py are separately inventoried reproducibility/diagnostic artifacts.
auxiliary_list_discrepancy.resolution: Inventory their union, all three full files, separately. No scientific file or frozen scope is changed.

historical_program_reason: No complete original mathematical code was supplied in the bound source edition.
formal_validation: Three scoped Lean files, nine declarations (two new, seven reused), separately inventoried; no full-source formalization.
excluded_source_clauses: Full Lean formalization, new question result or matched compression ratio
export_boundary: Metadata, exact hashes, furniture literals and occurrence-bound glyph calibration only. Primary PDFs, full extracted texts and source rasters remain private and outside exports.
